subject: estimate proportion of the phenotype variance explained

messages.author: 963b6d84a823404f
messages.subject: estimate proportion of the phenotype variance explained
parts:
> After running “marker regression” method for qtl mapping, I want to estimate proportion of the phenotypic variance explained by highly linked marker (genetic variation of highly linked marker). Would you please tell me using which code I can estimate it?

You can use fitqtl() or you can use the formula

1 - 10^(-(2/n)*LOD)

where n is the sample size. See pg 77 of the R/qtl book (http://www.rqtl.org/book)

karl
